The paper is novel and theoretically interesting, but the empirical evaluation requires a stronger control to robustly support the transfer claims.

Without a control baseline that trains a single model on the *pooled* data (source + target) without the specific pretraining/finetuning architecture, it is impossible to attribute the performance gains to "representation transfer" rather than "larger dataset size." This is the most critical weakness, as it challenges the core novelty of the "transfer" mechanism.

The authors speculate on an explanation but do not analyze whether the data regime hides this term or if the bound is loose in this aspect.
